channels.ibat: Information supply for crime prevention and investigation: an analyst bringing source records, a place map and evidence photographs together into one coherent operational picture. Connected source panels and a decisive human hand. No visible private data.
channels.vald: Serious organized violence, violence as a service and digital recruitment: a contemporary Swedish street and an anonymous adult seen beside a large phone with abstract message shapes, shadowy recruiting network in the distance. No injuries, guns or sensational crime reconstruction.
channels.sjoomradet: Maritime security in the Baltic: a merchant ship, Nordic rocky shore, harbor infrastructure and a clearly identifiable undersea communications cable. Strong ship silhouette.
channels.kek: Criminal finance: an investigator tracing asset transfers between company buildings, accounts and property through an elegant winding financial trail. Evidence documents in foreground. No generic money pile.
channels.lagstiftning: Swedish criminal law: contemporary Swedish courtroom with pale oak benches and a prominent legal volume and case folders. Nordic legal process, no American gavel.
channels.ai_brottsbekampning: Artificial intelligence in criminal investigation: human analyst checking machine assisted pattern recognition and image comparisons against source photographs. Strong human oversight and evidence verification. No robot face, no globe.
channels.it_juridik: Privacy and information law: secure personal records archive, a person presenting a permission card at an access gate, an accountable audit trail and segregated record drawers. Clearly about access rights and personal data.
channels.verksamhetsutveckling: Organizational development and implementation: a small team moving process cards from planning wall to a working service prototype. People, method, technology and practical change. No isolated gear icon.
